svg.title: School Fees Tracker: use case diagram
svg.desc: UML use case diagram. System boundary "School Fees Tracker". Actors: Administrator and Bursar (staff, left), Payer and Mobile Money Provider (external, right). Use cases inside the boundary; dashed include arrows (labelled «include») connect payment use cases to Generate receipt; the Administrator's link to Review online payments is view-only.
svg.text: Use case diagram: School Fees Tracker (CEF 345, Week 4)
